earnings.title: SharkNinja Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Adjusted Net Income increased 55.1% to $330.9 million.
Adjusted EBITDA increased 45.7% to $461.3 million, or 23.3% of net sales.
Mark Barrocas, Chief Executive Officer, commented: “Q3 net sales grew 21.2%, marking our second consecutive quarter above 20% and our 14th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.

items.heading: We believe that success comes when we communicate for impact.

Our business depends on maintaining and strengthening our brands to generate and maintain ongoing demand for our products, and a significant reduction in such demand, or misuse by licensees of our brands, could harm our business, financial condition and results of operations.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations and Industry

items.heading: If we are unable to commercialize a continuing stream of new products and line extensions that create demand, our ability to compete in the marketplace may be materially and adversely impacted.

items.heading: Past growth may not be indicative of future growth.

items.heading: We may be unable to manage our future growth effectively, which could make it difficult to execute our business strategy.

items.heading: Our net sales and profits depend on the level of consumer spending on our products, which is sensitive to general economic conditions and other factors; during a downturn in the economy, consumer purchases of discretionary items may be adversely affected, which could materially harm our business, financial condition and results of operations.
